D0.name: Distant background
D0.coverage: Silhouette/low-detail shell, distant material and visibility bounds only. Unnamed filler, not the default for a named destination.

D2.name: Explorable outdoor place
D2.coverage: Approach, walk-around exterior/open pavilion or court, focal view, exit/return route, local plants/props/ambience and simplified collision. No automatic furnished sealed interior.

D3.name: Explorable place plus selected interior/deck
D3.coverage: D2 plus one useful room or upper/deck route, furnished focal zones and a reusable interaction/access pattern. Forests use the shared cottage interior family; not bespoke rooms for every building.

D4.name: Hero hub
D4.coverage: D3 plus authored connected multi-zone routes and full hero hierarchy. Palace prototype first, then ten selected zones; no complete simulation of all enormous wings.

detail_bands_proposed.near_path: roughly0–20m: readable surfaces, hero plants/props, usable collision
detail_bands_proposed.middle: roughly20–150m: clustered instanced canopy/buildings with reduced detail
detail_bands_proposed.distant: beyond roughly150m: LOD/impostors/skyline; distances must be tuned to actual production camera
